fol.notes: Works are an uninterpreted sort; being a novel by Emily Brontë is a belief (novel_by, uninterpreted). w1 stores the count as a figure (number_of_members, ATTRIBUTES.md), which the insert does not recompute; w2 stores the counting rule over the stored list (an entry counts only if it differs from the earlier ones, so the new member's distinctness enters the count). Counting needs a closed world: every member the model knows is one of the named constants (presupposition named_only; Z3 does not need it to fix the value). The new member's distinctness from the stored one is part of the edit ('newly found').
